days.title: Easy run
days.note: Back in the groove, nothing more. Dry, 30s to low 50s: midday is warmest, after the 9am call. Record with Strava.

days.title: Long easy, zone 2
days.note: For your head, not your fitness. 60–75 min, slow enough to talk the whole way; walk any hill. Best window: 2:45 after the massage, back before dark (~4:30). Dry, mid-50s. Phone in your pocket, no pace watching. Sauna after if you can.

days.title: Hevy · Session A
days.note: Open Hevy → "Session A · Full body". Same weights as before; it's been two weeks, so 2 sets of each is fine if 3 feels like a lot.

days.title: Easy run
days.note: Dry, 50s. Midday if the calendar allows. Record with Strava.

days.title: Off
days.note: Birthday party. Sauna if you get a minute.
